Manufactured on KBA Rapida 105 4-color offset (15,000 sheets/hour) with Heidelberg Speedmaster CD 102 7+1 UV for specialty coatings (spot UV, soft-touch, glitter) in our 18,000 sqm Foshan facility. Ideal for cosmetics, confectionery, consumer electronics accessories, and health/beauty counter displays serving 500+ global brands since 2003.

Tuck-top auto-bottom folding cartons combine simple assembly with secure closure, making them the industry standard for food packaging. Ideal for:

Production Specifications

  • Press: KBA 1050 4-color offset + Heidelberg Speedmaster 7+1 UV
  • Food Safety: All inks and coatings are low-migration, food-grade certified; heavy metal content below EU 94/62/EC limits
  • Die-Cutting: Automatic Bobst-style flatbed die-cutting with ±0.5mm precision
  • Gluing: High-speed folder-gluer with auto-bottom attachment; inline window patching available
  • Lamination: Inline PE/PET extrusion lamination or offline film lamination
  • Daily Capacity: 1.7 million+ color boxes + 220K+ gift boxes per day
  • Lead Time: 8–12 working days for new orders; 5–8 days for repeats
  • MOQ: 1000–3000 units per design

Quality Assurance

  • ISO 9001:2015 certified quality management system
  • FSC Chain of Custody certified
  • Food Safety: GMP-compliant production environment; ink migration testing available on request
  • Incoming Inspection: Board caliper (±5%), moisture content, brightness verified
  • Inline QC: Color density every 500 sheets; glue bond and auto-bottom function tested hourly
  • Final Inspection: AQL 2.5 sampling; dimensional tolerance ±1.0mm; color delta E < 2.0
  • Free pre-production sample (freight collect)

Factory

  • 22 years of manufacturing excellence
  • 10,000 sqm production facility in Foshan, Guangdong, China
  • KBA 1050 4-color + Heidelberg 7+1 UV presses
  • High-speed folder-gluer lines with auto-bottom capability
  • Daily capacity: 1.7 million color boxes
  • Export to 40+ countries across Europe, North America, Middle East, and Southeast Asia

For direct food contact, we offer PE or PET inner liner that meets FDA 21 CFR and EU 1935/2004 food contact standards. We can provide migration test certificates from SGS or Intertek.
